protocol.pca: independent centered full-SVD PCA, equal atom weight, no scaling
protocol.neighbors: 10 Euclidean neighbors in 128D, exclude every atom of query structure
protocol.aggregation: mean over query atoms within structure, then mean over structures
protocol.interval: 2000 paired structure bootstrap draws; fixed checkpoints and atom sample
protocol.selection: top four by structure coverage; joint ranks minimum coverage across domains

without_properties.embedding: per-atom backbone output Q_L in transformed AtomArray order, before task heads

with_properties.embedding: per-atom backbone output Q_L in transformed AtomArray order, before task heads
